use_SDToolName_enum: use the SDToolName enum to select a success detection tool variant like SubtaskSuccessDetectorV4 or PedalTriggeredSuccessDetector
configure_agent_model_flags: set agent model name, temperature, and max output tokens via the AGENTIC_AGENT_MODEL_NAME and related flags
configure_success_detection_flags: configure success detection with flags for model name, thinking budget, ensemble size, and timeout seconds
configure_framework_control_flags: set the framework control mode, external controller host and port, and simulate communication flags
configure_logging_flags: enable logging, set the robot ID, output directory, and agent session ID via the logging flags
